title: Open-Faced Steak Sandwich with Caramelized Onion and Tomato Caprese Salad
description: This open-faced sandwich features pan-fried steak topped with sweet caramelized onions and garlic mayo on toasted ciabatta. A fresh Caprese salad with marinated tomatoes, oregano, and bocconcini provides a light accompaniment.

steps.instruction:
Preheat your broiler to high.
Wash and dry all produce.
Halve the tomatoes.
Roughly chop 1 tbsp oregano.
Pat steak dry with paper towel, then season with salt and pepper.

Heat a large non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add 1 tbsp oil, then add the sliced onions.
Cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly softened.

Add 1 tsp sugar to the onions and season with salt.
Cook, stirring occasionally, until onions are golden-brown.

Remove the pan from heat.
Stir in 1 tbsp vinegar until onions are coated.
Transfer caramelized onions to a small bowl and set aside.
Carefully wipe the pan clean.

Heat the same pan over medium-high heat.
Add 1 tbsp oil, then add the steak.
Pan-fry until cooked to desired doneness.

Remove pan from heat.
Transfer steak to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Set aside to rest.

Toss together tomatoes, oregano, remaining 1 tbsp vinegar, and 1 tbsp oil in a large bowl.
Season with salt and pepper.
Set aside.

Peel, then mince or grate the garlic.
Stir together mayo and ¼ tsp minced garlic in a small bowl.
Set aside.

Halve ciabatta buns.
On a baking sheet, arrange ciabatta halves cut side up and brush each half with 1 tsp oil.
Toast in middle of oven until golden-brown.

Thinly slice the steak.
Spread garlic-mayo over toasted ciabatta halves, then top with steak and caramelized onions.
Divide open-faced sandwiches between plates.
Tear bocconcini into bite-sized pieces over the marinated tomatoes.
Season tomatoes with salt and pepper and serve on the side.
